summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by LG Display Co., Ltd., a foreign private issuer, notifying the SEC of a non-deal roadshow scheduled for July 28-30, 2026 in Seoul, sponsored by iM Securities. The roadshow involves one-on-one meetings with domestic institutional investors to discuss Q2 2026 financial results and Q&A. The filing contains no special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, or other event-driven corporate action. It is a routine notification of an investor relations activity.
